spanish: Y daré favor de este pueblo en ojos de Egipto, y será que andarán, no andarán vacíos.

findings.issue: Adverb רֵיקָם rendered as agreeing adjective vacíos; meaning preserved as grammatical smoothing.

notes: 1cs give + construct favor of this people in Egypt’s eyes; 2mp go / not go kept as ustedes andarán.
